status: preparation only; artwork candidate awaiting user review; no animation renderer connected
coordinate_system: source pixels, origin top left; inclusive polygon coordinates

output.note: Native plate 1672x941; 4K delivery would be resampled, not native 4K detail.

loop_rules: One configured duration, no duplicate endpoint
Forward transport with invisible local particle resets; no ping-pong or full-frame dissolve
Match state and velocity through encoded seam; verify every layer and full encoded composite
Test unquantized natural speed first; quantify speed changes if cycle quantization alters slow effects

inspection_performed: Generated still inspected for text removal, composition and photographic lighting

protected_geometry: All room surfaces, furniture, beaker silhouette, window/door frames and glass marks
Sluice gate, railings, service pipes, fixed waterline and marsh vegetation
Colony architecture and mast; moon removed from moving texture source as well as output exclusion
Steady desk lamp and global exposure
principal_motion: Broad water reflection bands visibly travel across the open right-hand channel
Cloud formations drift horizontally above the colony without shifting moon or ridge

layers.name: sky
layers.mask_status: draft source-coordinate mask; edge/occlusion review required before animation
layers.method: Adapt Basalt source-cloud transport; shared world-space sampling through separate window apertures
layers.visual_acceptance: A recognizable cloud edge travels 12-20 source pixels in 8 seconds; no doubling, sliding frame texture or replicated moon.

layers.name: water
layers.mask_status: draft source-coordinate mask; edge/occlusion review required before animation
layers.method: Adapt Glacier 24-wave reflection method with channel perspective calibrated to this camera
layers.visual_acceptance: Broad restrained reflection deformation visible at 720p; never liquid concrete, drifting reeds, fast glints or glowing stripes. Draft open-water polygons need shoreline/reed refinement.

layers.name: screen
layers.mask_status: draft source-coordinate mask; edge/occlusion review required before animation
layers.method: Perspective-confined telemetry mark on existing screen
layers.visual_acceptance: Small slow chart marker readable without replacing the screen, moving bezel or flickering.

layers.name: colony_windows
layers.mask_status: draft source-coordinate mask; edge/occlusion review required before animation
layers.method: Independent full-aperture light schedules with limited coupled spill
layers.visual_acceptance: Two or three distinct window changes; no synchronized blinking and no unmasked white cores.

layers.name: mast

build_order: refine water geometry/masks before adding supports
implementation_notes: These mask regions are deliberately conservative draft calibration, not final segmentation.
Do not apply water_surface.py unchanged: its perspective mapping and sampled reflection repair need this channel's coordinates.
Skip beaker steam in the first build; principal scene motion must work first.
Left and main windows must sample one coherent external atmosphere.
